processing.decode: AAC (M4A, 44.1 kHz stereo) decoded; channels are identical (verified per clip), channel 1 kept as mono
processing.trim: leading/trailing silence removed, including faint isolated breaths/clicks more than 150 ms from the sound (detection at -40 dB from the clip's peak); 40 ms kept before onset, 120 ms after offset. One recording (media42.m4a) says three sounds in a row; only its first sound is kept (see 'kept' on the u_e and ew clips)
processing.fades: 5 ms fade-in and 30 ms fade-out, applied to the silent pads only
processing.volume: single fixed gain per clip towards -14 dBFS loudest-50 ms RMS, peak capped at -1 dBFS; no compression or limiting
processing.encode: MP3, mono, 44.1 kHz, 96 kbps CBR, source metadata not copied
